codex.healthy:

[hooks]
[[hooks.PermissionRequest]]
matcher = '*'

[[hooks.PermissionRequest.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PermissionRequest --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.PostCompact]]
[[hooks.PostCompact.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PostCompact --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.PostToolUse]]

[[hooks.SessionStart]]

[[hooks.SessionStart.hooks]]

timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.Stop]]

timeout = 30
